A Extração Aconex usa a API oficial, e e:
The Aconex Extraction uses the official API, which requires your own OAuth credential. It has three parts, which the Aconex administrator gives you when registering the application in your name:

• Client ID (APP ID): identifies that application. It usually looks like SCP_SEU_NOME_ACONEX_client_APPID.
• User ID: your Aconex account number. Digits only, for example 1208560183.
• Client Secret: the application's password. It is the only secret part.

The Client Secret is stored only on this computer, encrypted by Windows in your user account. It never goes to GitHub or to the program folder, and it keeps working after DocManager updates.
